allow: PowerShell($token = \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:8080/realms/master/protocol/openid-connect/token" -Method Post -Body "grant_type=password&client_id=admin-cli&username=admin&password=admin" -ContentType "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" -UseBasicParsing\).Content | ConvertFrom-Json | Select-Object -ExpandProperty access_token; $clients = \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/demo/clients?clientId=spiffe-service" -Headers @{Authorization="Bearer $token"} -UseBasicParsing\).Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $clients | Select-Object clientId, enabled, serviceAccountsEnabled, secret)
